This 2023 Porsche 911 GT3 RS is a highly specified example finished in White over a Black Leather and Race-Tex interior accented by GT Silver and Mamba Green deviated stitching. Factory equipped with the Weissach Package, Porsche Ceramic Composite Brakes, forged lightweight magnesium wheels, and a bespoke Tribute to Carrera RS interior, this car represents one of the most focused road-legal 911s ever produced.

Power comes from Porsches naturally aspirated 4.0-liter flat-six paired with a seven-speed PDK dual-clutch transmission driving the rear wheels. The 992-generation GT3 RS builds on decades of motorsport development, featuring advanced active aerodynamics, extensive carbon-fiber construction, and a chassis engineered for maximum performance on track while remaining street-legal.

The factory warranty began on November 4, 2023.

Factory Highlights

* Weissach Package
* Porsche Ceramic Composite Brakes with high-gloss black calipers
* 20-inch front and 21-inch rear forged lightweight magnesium wheels
* Front Axle Lift System
* Extended Range Fuel Tank
* Tribute to Carrera RS custom interior package
* Deviated stitching interior package in Mamba Green

Exterior

The exterior is finished in White and features the full suite of GT3 RS aerodynamic elements, including the swan-neck rear wing, functional hood vents, front fender louvers, and an aggressive front splitter. Carbon-fiber components throughout the bodywork are included as part of the Weissach Package, reducing weight while increasing rigidity and downforce.

Black LED headlights with Porsche Dynamic Light System and Exclusive Design taillights complete the exterior presentation. The magnesium wheels reduce unsprung mass and highlight the optional ceramic braking system.

Interior

The cockpit is trimmed in Black Leather and Race-Tex with GT Silver stitching, further enhanced by extensive Mamba Green deviated stitching as part of the Tribute to Carrera RS interior. Mamba Green stitching is applied to the dashboard, door panels, knee pads, rear side panels, and center console lid, which also features an RS logo.

Additional interior features include ambient lighting, BOSE surround sound, leather-trimmed air vent surrounds and slats in Mamba Green, auto-dimming mirrors with integrated rain sensor, and rear ParkAssist.

Chassis and Performance

The naturally aspirated 4.0-liter flat-six delivers immediate throttle response and a race-inspired soundtrack, while the PDK transmission provides rapid, precise gear changes. The Weissach Package incorporates extensive carbon-fiber components, and the lightweight magnesium wheels further enhance handling by reducing rotational mass.

The Front Axle Lift System allows for additional clearance at low speeds, and the extended range fuel tank increases usability for longer drives and track sessions.

description: This 2016 Porsche Cayman GT4 was converted into a race car by DeMan Motorsport, with over $100K in upgrades. The gearbox was overhauled with a Guard limited-slip differential, shortened 2-5 gear ratios, and a race-specification clutch and lightweight flywheel. Engine management is from a MoTeC system. The engine and gearbox have less than 24 hours of use since installation.

This Silverado 2500HD LT is packed with premium features that will elevate your driving experience. The Convenience Package includes dual-zone automatic climate control, a 10-way power driver's seat, and a tilt/telescoping steering column for exceptional comfort and control. The Convenience Package II adds even more convenience with features like Hitch Guidance, the Trailering App, and a rear sliding power window.

Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.

The 2024 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 ZR2 Bison Edition delivers exceptional value by including substantial standard equipment not always found in similarly-priced full-size trucks. Heated front and rear leather seats, a premium Bose 7-speaker system, dual-zone automatic climate control, and a sunroof are bundled at no extra cost, strengthening its feature-to-price ratio against alternatives that often charge for similar amenities.

Analytical buyers seeking maximum return on investment will appreciate the Silverado ZR2’s robust standard features and advanced technology suite. This truck is designed for those who scrutinize spec sheets and expect comprehensive safety, comfort, and performance equipment without costly add-ons. Its ZR2 Bison Edition and Technology Package combine high-end off-road and tech features, making it ideal for value-focused shoppers who want a feature-rich, reliable pickup.

The Silverado ZR2’s 6.2L V8 engine, paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD, delivers 420 horsepower and 460 lb-ft of torque—figures that outclass most rivals at this price point. The power-to-price ratio is competitive, especially considering the ZR2 Bison’s specialized suspension and dual active exhaust. Maintenance costs are managed by a proven GM V8 powertrain, while the auxiliary oil and transmission coolers add long-term durability, reducing lifetime expenditures.

Safety value is a highlight with standard Automatic Emergency Braking, Lane Keep Assist with Departure Warning, Forward Collision Alert, Front Pedestrian Braking, and IntelliBeam automatic high beams. Unlike many competitors where these features are optional, the Silverado ZR2 Bison includes them as standard, providing safety innovation with no upcharge. Four-wheel disc brakes, ABS, and a full airbag suite further ensure occupant protection as standard equipment.

Every ZR2 Bison comes loaded with features that frequently cost extra elsewhere: perforated leather seating, heated and ventilated front seats, heated rear seats, power sunroof, and a Technology Package with garage door transmitter and rain-sensing wipers. The Premium Bose audio system, Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium with SiriusXM 360L, Wi-Fi hotspot capability, and memory seat function elevate both convenience and luxury—without requiring additional packages or upgrades.

When evaluating against the Ford F-150 Tremor and Ram 1500 Rebel, the Silverado ZR2 Bison stands out by including features standard that are often bundled into higher trims or extra-cost packages on competitors. Its off-road suspension, premium audio, and suite of driver aids make it a high-value choice for buyers who prioritize equipment and durability over superficial add-ons.

Key standard equipment includes a heavy-duty battery, 170/220 amp alternators, block heater, heated steering wheel, and advanced infotainment. Value is clear as similar trucks often require expensive upgrades for the same features. The 3LT ZR2 Bison trim is recommended for its comprehensive package, offering a blend of luxury, tech, and off-road capability. Many features costing extra on rivals are included here, answering the question of worth with a clear "yes."

Maximizing value without compromising quality, Bayway Chevrolet invites you to experience the 2024 Silverado 1500 ZR2 Bison Edition. For more information or to schedule a test drive, contact 281-719-9821 or visit 5719 Broadway St, Pearland, TX, 77581. Boasting a commanding 3.4L V6 engine and 10-speed automatic transmission, the Tundra Limited delivers exceptional performance and efficiency. With its 4WD system, you'll enjoy confident handling and the ability to tackle any terrain. The impressive fuel economy, with 17 MPG in the city and 22 MPG on the highway, ensures you can go the distance without frequent stops.

The standout features of this Tundra Limited include:

- POWER PACKAGE: Includes a 120V Deck & Cabin Power Supply and Wireless Charger for your convenience
- SPECIAL COLOR: Elevate your style with the stunning White exterior

In addition, this Tundra is equipped with a wealth of advanced technology and premium amenities:

- 9-Speaker Audio System with SiriusXM Radio
- Dual-Zone Automatic Climate Control
- Heated and Ventilated Front Seats
- Power-Adjustable Driver's Seat with Memory Function
- Wireless Smartphone Charging
- Integrated Navigation System
- Rearview Camera with Dynamic Gridlines

The Tundra Limited's impressive capabilities are matched by its refined interior and thoughtful design. From the leather-wrapped steering wheel to the spacious and comfortable cabin, every detail has been meticulously crafted to provide a premium driving experience.

Safety is also a top priority, with features like Automatic Emergency Braking, Lane Departure Warning, and Blind Spot Monitoring keeping you and your passengers secure on the road.

Experience the pinnacle of full-size truck performance and luxury with the 2024 Toyota Tundra Limited. Schedule a test drive today and discover how this exceptional vehicle can elevate your driving experience.
